description: UCI row 54 (age 57, MEDIUM vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 1, horizon 3yr) — global equity etf: soft fails ['R2', 'R3'] (score 65) -> CONDITIONAL
client_narrative: Ljiljana Marić is 57 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 60,000 euros (around 5,000 euros per month). They hold 1,600 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 2,800 euros with a 3-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is very conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 1 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 2,800 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
